QUOTE: An allow hit skips the prompt. It does not bypass the deny check, which runs later.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says an allow match only skips the approval prompt and does not bypass the later deny check. It also places the allow check in `check_approval` (`tool_tcall_executor.cpp`) and the deny check in `ServerManager::execute` (`server_manager.cpp`), so the different-file location is named.
